verses.en: Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty man of valour, and he was the son of an harlot: and Gilead begat Jephthah.
verses.sm: Iefata ma lana tauto Kiliata, o le toa malosi lava ja, o le tama a le fafine talitane, na fanaua Iefata e Kiliata.

verses.en: And Gilead's wife bare him sons; and his wife's sons grew up, and they thrust out Jephthah, and said unto him, Thou shalt not inherit in our father's house; for thou art the son of a strange woman.
verses.sm: Na fanau mai le ava a Kiliata o tama tane ia te ja; ua matutua tama tane a le fafine, ona latou tulia lea o Iefata, ma latou fai atu ia te ia, E te le maua se tofi i le aiga o lo matou tama, aua o oe le tama a le fafine ese.

verses.en: Then Jephthah fled from his brethren, and dwelt in the land of Tob: and there were gathered vain men to Jephthah, and went out with him.
verses.sm: Ona sola ese ai lea o Iefata i ona uso, ua nofo i le nuu o Topa; ona faapotopoto atu ai lea ia Iefata o tagata faatauvaa, ua latou feoai ma ia.

verses.en: And it came to pass in process of time, that the children of Ammon made war against Israel.
verses.sm: Чa oo i ona aso na tau ai le fanauga a Amoni ma Isaraelu.

verses.en: And it was so, that when the children of Ammon made war against Israel, the elders of Gilead went to fetch Jephthah out of the land of Tob:
verses.sm: Ua oo ina a tau le fanauga a Amoni ma Isaraelu, ona o atu lea o toeaina o Kiliata e aami ia Iefata i le nuu o Topa.

verses.en: And they said unto Jephthah, Come, and be our captain, that we may fight with the children of Ammon.
verses.sm: Ua latou fai atu ia Iefata, Maliu mai ia, ina fai oe ma alii e avea ‘au ia i matou, ina la tatou tau ma le fanauga a Amoni.

verses.en: And Jephthah said unto the elders of Gilead, Did not ye hate me, and expel me out of my father's house? and why are ye come unto me now when ye are in distress?
verses.sm: A ua fai mai lefata i toeaina o Kiliata, E le na outou “ino'ino ea ia te au, ma tuli ia te au ai le fale o loʻu tama; o le a foi le mea ua outou O mai ai nei ia te au ina o tigaina outou?

verses.en: And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah, Therefore we turn again to thee now, that thou mayest go with us, and fight against the children of Ammon, and be our head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o toeaina o Kiliata ia Iefata, O le mea lava lea ua matou toe faasaga mai ai ia te oe, tatou te maliu ma i matou, ma e tau ma le fanauga a Amoni, ona e fai lea ma alii sili i e nonofo uma lava i Kiliata.

verses.en: And Jephthah said unto the elders of Gilead, If ye bring me home again to fight against the children of Ammon, and the LORD deliver them before me, shall I be your head?
verses.sm: Ona fai mai lea o Iefata i toeaina o Kiliata, Afai tatou te foi ma outou e tau ma le fanauga a Amoni, a foaiina mai foi i latou ja te au e le ALII, e faia ea aʻu ma alii sili ia te outou?

verses.en: And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah, The LORD be witness between us, if we do not so according to thy words.
verses.sm: to Ua fai atu toeaina o Kiliata ia Iefata, E faafofoga mai le ALII ia i tatou, pe afai matou te le faia e tusa ma lau fetalaiga.

verses.en: Then Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead, and the people made him head and captain over them: and Jephthah uttered all his words before the LORD in Mizpeh.
verses.sm: Ona 6 lea o Iefata ma toeaina o Kiliata; ona tofia lea o ia e le nuu e fai ma alii sili ma ave “au ia i latou. Ua fai ane e Iefata ana upu uma i luma o le ALII i Mesepa.

verses.en: And Jephthah sent messengers unto the king of the children of Ammon, saying, What hast thou to do with me, that thou art come against me to fight in my land?
verses.sm: Ona awna atu lea e Iefata o le savali i le tupu o le fanauga a Amoni, ua faapea, Se a se mea o i ai ia te i taџa ma aʻu, ina ua e sau ia te au e tau i loʻu lava laueleele?

verses.en: And the king of the children of Ammon answered unto the messengers of Jephthah, Because Israel took away my land, when they came up out of Egypt, from Arnon even unto Jabbok, and unto Jordan: now therefore restore those lands again peaceably.
verses.sm: Ua fai mai le tupu o le fanauga a Amoni i le savali a Iefata, Aua ua faoa e Isaraelu loʻu laueleele i lona alu ae i Aikupito, e pau mai Arinona e pau atu i lapoka, a e oo atu i Ioritana; o lenei, ia toe tuu mai ai ma le filemu.

verses.en: And Jephthah sent messengers again unto the king of the children of Ammon:
verses.sm: Ona toe aauina atu ai lea e Iefata o le savali i le tupu o le fanauga a Amoni,

verses.en: And said unto him, Thus saith Jephthah, Israel took not away the land of Moab, nor the land of the children of Ammon:
verses.sm: ua fai atu ia te ia, O loo faapea mai Iefata, E lei faoa lava e Isaraelu le laueleele o Moapi, ma le laueleele o le fanauga a Amoni;

verses.en: But when Israel came up from Egypt, and walked through the wilderness unto the Red sea, and came to Kadesh;
verses.sm: aua na ae mai Isaraelu i Aikupito, ma ui ane i le vao, e oo i le sami Ulaula; ua oo atu i Katesa.

verses.en: Then Israel sent messengers unto the king of Edom, saying, Let me, I pray thee, pass through thy land: but the king of Edom would not hearken thereto. And in like manner they sent unto the king of Moab: but he would not consent: and Israel abode in Kadesh.
verses.sm: Ona aauina atu lea e Isaraelu o le savali i le tupu o Etoma, o loo faapea, Seʻi ou ui ane i lou nuu. A e le faalogo mai le tupu o Etoma, na aauina atu foi nisi i le tupu o Moapi, a e le mafai o ia; ona nofo ai lea o Isaraelu i Katesa.

verses.en: Then they went along through the wilderness, and compassed the land of Edom, and the land of Moab, and came by the east side of the land of Moab, and pitched on the other side of Arnon, but came not within the border of Moab: for Arnon was the border of Moab.
verses.sm: Ona latou ui atu lea i le vao, ma latou faataamilo i le nuu o Etoma ma le nuu o Moapi; ua latou oo atu ai i le mea e alu ae ai le la i le nuu o Moapi, ma latou to lauapi i le la itu o Arinona, a e lei sopoia lc tuaoi o Moapi; aua o Arinona o le tuaoi lea o Moapi.

verses.en: And Israel sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites, the king of Heshbon; and Israel said unto him, Let us pass, we pray thee, through thy land into my place.
verses.sm: Ona aauina lea e Isaraelu o le savali ia Sekono le tupu o sa Amori, le tupu o Hesepona, ua faapea atu ai Isaraelu ia te ia, Seʻi ou ui ane i lou laueleele e oo atu ai i loʻu nuu.

verses.en: But Sihon trusted not Israel to pass through his coast: but Sihon gathered all his people together, and pitched in Jahaz, and fought against Israel.
verses.sm: A e lei talia e Sekono le upu a Isaraelu, ina ia latou ui ane i lona nuu; ua faapotopoto foi e Sekono i lona nuu uma lava, ua to lauapi i laesa; ona latou tau ai lea ma Isaraelu.

verses.en: And the LORD God of Israel delivered Sihon and all his people into the hand of Israel, and they smote them: so Israel possessed all the land of the Amorites, the inhabitants of that country.
verses.sm: Ona tuuina atu lea e le ALII le Atua o Isaraelu o Sekono ma lona nuu uma i le lima o Isaraelu, ua latou fafasi ia i latou; na maua foi e Isaraelu le nuu uma lava o sa Amori o e sa nonofo i lea nuu.

verses.en: And they possessed all the coasts of the Amorites, from Arnon even unto Jabbok, and from the wilderness even unto Jordan.
verses.sm: Na latou maua le laueleele uma lava o sa Amori, e pau mai i Arinona, a e pau mai i lapoka; e pau atu i le vao, e oo atu i Ioritana.

verses.en: So now the LORD God of Israel hath dispossessed the Amorites from before his people Israel, and shouldest thou possess it?
verses.sm: O lenei, o le Acn le Atua o Isaraelu na ia tuli ese atu i sa Amori ai luma o lona nuu o Isaraelu, a e fai ea mo oe?

verses.en: Wilt not thou possess that which Chemosh thy god giveth thee to possess? So whomsoever the LORD our God shall drive out from before us, them will we possess.
verses.sm: O le mea e avane ai e Kimosa lou atua ia te oe, e te le taofia ea mo oe? o mea uma foi e au mai ai e le ALII lo matou Atua mo i matou, matou te taofia lava mo i matou.

verses.en: And now art thou any thing better than Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab? did he ever strive against Israel, or did he ever fight against them,
verses.sm: O lenei pe sili ea oe ia Palako le atalii o Seporu, le tupu o Moapi? pe na fai ea e ia se finauga ma Isaraelu? pe na tau ea e ia se taua ma i latou,

verses.en: While Israel dwelt in Heshbon and her towns, and in Aroer and her towns, and in all the cities that be along by the coasts of Arnon, three hundred years? why therefore did ye not recover them within that time?
verses.sm: a o nofo Isaraelu i Hesepona ma ona faoa aai, ma Aroeru ma ona faoa aai, ma aai uma e lata ane i Arinona, e tolu galau ona tausaga? Se a le mea na outou le fao ai i ona po ia?

verses.en: Wherefore I have not sinned against thee, but thou doest me wrong to war against me: the LORD the Judge be judge this day between the children of Israel and the children of Ammon.
verses.sm: O aʻu foi, ou te lei agasala atu ia te oe; a o oe, ua e agaleaga mai ia te au, ina ua sii mai le taua ia te au; o le ALII le faamasino, ia faamasino ‚e ia i lenei aso i le fanauga a Isaraelu ma le fanauga a Amoni.

verses.en: Howbeit the king of the children of Ammon hearkened not unto the words of Jephthah which he sent him.
verses.sm: A ua le faalogo mai le tupu o le fanauga a Amoni i upu a Iefata na ia molia ia te ia.

verses.en: Then the Spirit of the LORD came upon Jephthah, and he passed over Gilead, and Manasseh, and passed over Mizpeh of Gilead, and from Mizpeh of Gilead he passed over unto the children of Ammon.
verses.sm: Ua oo ia lefata le Agaga O le ALII, ona alu ane lea o ia i Kiliata ma Manase, ua ia alu ane foi i Mesepa i Kiliata; ona alu ane lea o ia nai Mesepa i Kiliata i le fanauga a Amoni.

verses.en: And Jephthah vowed a vow unto the LORD, and said, If thou shalt without fail deliver the children of Ammon into mine hands,
verses.sm: Ona faia lea e Iefata le tauto i le ALII, O loo faapea, Afai e te tuuna mai lava le fanauga a Amoni i loʻu lima;

verses.en: Then it shall be, that whatsoever cometh forth of the doors of my house to meet me, when I return in peace from the children of Ammon, shall surely be the LORD'S, and I will offer it up for a burnt offering.
verses.sm: ona fai lea mo le ALII o se na te ulufafo i faitotoa o lo‘u fale e faafetaiai ia te au i lo‘u foi atu ma le manuia nai le fanauga a Amoni; pe ou te fai ai le tawada mu.

verses.en: So Jephthah passed over unto the children of Ammon to fight against them; and the LORD delivered them into his hands.
verses.sm: Ona alu ane lea o lefata i le fanauga a Amoni e tau ma i latou; ua tuuina atu foi i latou e le ALI i lona lima.

verses.en: And he smote them from Aroer, even till thou come to Minnith, even twenty cities, and unto the plain of the vineyards, with a very great slaughter. Thus the children of Ammon were subdued before the children of Israel.
verses.sm: Ua ia fasia i latou, e afua mai i Aroeru, e oo atu i Meniti, o aai e luafulu, e oo atu lava i Apela-karame, o le fasi e matua tele lava; ua faatoilaloina ai le fanauga a Amoni i luma o le fanauga a Isaraelu.

verses.en: And Jephthah came to Mizpeh unto his house, and, behold, his daughter came out to meet him with timbrels and with dances: and she was his only child; beside her he had neither son nor daughter.
verses.sm: Ona alu atu lea o lefata i Mesepa i lona fale; faauta foi, O lona afafine ua ulufafo mai e faafetaiai ia te ia ma topa ma siva; o lona afafine e toatasi o ia, ua leai sona atalii po o se afafine, ua na o ia lava.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when he saw her, that he rent his clothes, and said, Alas, my daughter! thou hast brought me very low, and thou art one of them that trouble me: for I have opened my mouth unto the LORD, and I cannot go back.
verses.sm: Ua iloa atu o ia, ona saei lea e ia ona ofu, ua fai atu, Aue! loʻu afafine e, ua e tanna faatigaina a‘u; o loo ua e faatasi ma e faaatuatuvale ia te au; o au foi, ua ou tautala atu i le ALII, ou te le mafai ona faafoi mai laʻu upu.

verses.en: And she said unto him, My father, if thou hast opened thy mouth unto the LORD, do to me according to that which hath proceeded out of thy mouth; forasmuch as the LORD hath taken vengeance for thee of thine enemies, even of the children of Ammon.
verses.sm: Ona tali mai lea o ia ia te ia, Sena e, ua e tautala atu ea i le ALII? ia e faia ia te aue tusa ma lau na ua e fai atu ai; ina ua uma ona taui atu e le ALII ona o oe i e na ita mai ia te oe o le fa~ nauga a Amoni.

verses.en: And she said unto her father, Let this thing be done for me: let me alone two months, that I may go up and down upon the mountains, and bewail my virginity, I and my fellows.
verses.sm: Ua ia fai mai foi i lona tama, Ia e faia lenei mea ia te au; tuu mai ia te au i masina e lua, ou te alu atu, ma ou ifoifo i luga o mauga, ma ou tagi Ona O loʻu taupou, o au atoa ma aʻu uo.

verses.en: And he said, Go. And he sent her away for two months: and she went with her companions, and bewailed her virginity upon the mountains.
verses.sm: Oa ia fai atu, Ina alu ia oe; ona tuu atu lea o ia ia te ia i masina e lua; ua alu atu o ia ma ana uo, ua tagi ona O lona taupou i luga O mauga.

verses.en: And it came to pass at the end of two months, that she returned unto her father, who did with her according to his vow which he had vowed: and she knew no man. And it was a custom in Israel,
verses.sm: Ua oo ina mavae O masina e lua, ona foi ai lea o ia i lona tama; ua ja faia ia te ia lana tauto sa na tauto ai; o ia foi ua le iloa se tanc. Ona fai lea ma tu ia Isaraelu,

verses.en: That the daughters of Israel went yearly to lament the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite four days in a year.
verses.sm: o lea tausaga ma lea tausaga ua o ai afafine o Isaraelu e vivii i le afafine o Iefata le Kiliata e taifa aso i tausaga.
